## Validation checklist

- [ ] `make validate` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make reproduce` passes, or `make checksums` was run for a deliberate change and the change is explained above
- [ ] No goal text was added for a source repository with no licence
- [ ] No label status was set to `reviewed` or `adjudicated` by a script or bot
- [ ] Every changed label has a `history` entry (date, who, change, reason)
- [ ] The codebook version was bumped if a rule changed, with a change-log entry and the list of affected tasks
- [ ] Counts shown on the site still come from `counts.json` (no typed numbers)
- [ ] Wording follows the writing rules in CONTRIBUTING.md (first mention "MITRE ATT&CK®", no implied MITRE affiliation)
